info.name: CHP folder tags
info.summary: Tag files by team folder (CUI, FCI) and refuse copies and moves out of contained team folders.
info.description: CyberHygiene appliance control app. Policy in app config (set by chp-site): rules = {"team folder id": "system tag id"}, contain = [team folder ids], contain_allow = [[from id, to id]]. Audit events chp.contain.refused, chp.tag.applied, chp.tag.failed and chp.app.disabled go to the admin_audit log file. occ chp:foldertag:check lists untagged files.
info.author: The CyberHygiene Project
